parameters.name: Num
parameters.description: The number of entries to return. Default value: 100.

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: SaleId
parameters.description: The ID of the Anti-DDoS Diversion instance.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the instance. Valid values:

- normal: The instance is running normally.

- expired: The instance has expired.

- deleting: The instance is being deleted.

- stopped: The instance is stopped.
